The target is the instantaneous voltage derivative, with voltage and adaptation evolved together as coupled neural states.

  A [S] — Slow nonnegative hyperpolarizing adaptation-current magnitude in picoamperes with saturating depolarization-dependent recruitment
  membrane_capacitance [S] — Effective membrane capacitance in picofarads, slowly increased by sustained depolarization and relaxing toward a depolarization-dependent target above baseline

  leak_conductance [P] — Baseline passive membrane leak conductance near rest in nanosiemens
  resting_voltage [P] — Passive resting or leak-reversal voltage in millivolts
  adaptation_gain [P] — Small-depolarization adaptation recruitment gain in picoamperes per millivolt of depolarization above resting voltage
  adaptation_time_constant [P] — Positive adaptation recruitment and relaxation time constant in milliseconds
  leak_rectification_strength [P] — Strength of subthreshold voltage-dependent leak rectification per millivolt squared
  adaptation_saturation_scale [P] — Positive depolarization scale in millivolts at which adaptation recruitment begins to saturate
  capacitance_recruitment_gain [P] — Dimensionless gain setting the fractional increase of effective capacitance recruited by sustained depolarization
  capacitance_time_constant [P] — Positive time constant for slow capacitance recruitment and relaxation in milliseconds
  capacitance_recruitment_scale [P] — Positive depolarization scale in millivolts at which capacitance recruitment begins to saturate
